srList.sentence: Part 2: Field-Testing Design The vCST protocol was field tested in five countries and feedback was gathered from facilitators. vCST was delivered through a randomised controlled trial in the UK and Ireland. In Brazil, Hong Kong, and India, vCST was delivered as a pre-post study.
